dropped.item: Concrete examples of extras not covered (flowers, catering, a venue)
Acknowledgement that prepaid plans can feel like a kind and sensible thing to do
Advice to think carefully before you sign
The account is one 'they control', which is the point of the alternative
The reassurance that you can come away from the chat with nothing more than a clearer idea of your options

changed.item: 'A plan may only cover certain services' became the definitive 'a pre paid funeral plan only covers certain services', implying all plans are limited
'Some people are better served' became 'For many people', which widens the scope
'Plans can be hard to change' became 'Another issue can be if you need to change your plan', which no longer clearly says changing is difficult
'An account they control' became 'a bank account'

added.item: Claim that 'by rights a pre paid funeral plan should cover all of this' (the full £4,200), setting up an expectation not in the original
'What many people don't realise', a claim about public awareness
'We always give people 30 minutes', which adds 'always'
